details: The agent successfully executed both planned analyses in universal_schema.json. The final R script used the authorized wage_gain_table.xlsx dataset, constructed log_wage_gain as log(lastUsWageAdjusted) - log(lastHomeWageAdjusted), applied the planned education cutoffs edyrs < 9 versus edyrs >= 16, used college_degree as the reference group, and estimated the specified OLS models. Task1 included the planned controls female, age_at_us_job, age_at_us_job squared, and country fixed effects. Task2 used the pooled sample including Mexico and included no controls, consistent with the Task2 restriction. The reported coefficients, standard errors, p-values, confidence intervals, percent differences, and group counts match the executed output. The repairs documented by the agent were limited to file-path resolution and output extraction/printing, which do not constitute substantive deviations from the proposed analysis.
